*Generate images in a user’s consistent brand style and refine that style through explicit feedback.*

> **Every generation uses the selected versioned brand profile; only explicit durable feedback changes that profile, and a one-off image request never silently rewrites the brand.**

## Why install this

Generate images in a user’s consistent brand style and refine that style through explicit feedback. It ships the method as well as the commands: 4 steps the machine decides outright, and 3 the model has to judge, with the line between them written down in `skill-invariants.json` rather than left to taste.

A versioned visual profile keeps medium, palette and signature consistent while each image gets its own subject. Explicit feedback refines lighting, texture, composition, typography and avoid-lists. Approved images can become reusable references. One-off requests stay local to that image.

Learning updates saved preferences and references; it does not train model weights or guarantee identical pixels. Every generated image receives a visual review, and drift is reported rather than silently redefining the brand.

## What you get

| Path | What it provides |
|---|---|
| `skills/brand-images/SKILL.md` | What the agent reads: triggers, the flow, and the one rule. |
| `skills/brand-images/scripts/` | The deterministic half — `profile`, `brief`, `feedback`, `validate`. |
| `skills/brand-images/references/profile.md` | Profile schema: style anchors, adjustable preferences, palette, medium, composition, lighting, texture, typography, avoid-list, approved reference images and source-backed revisions.. |
| `skills/brand-images/references/generation.md` | Host-conditional generation adapters: Codex image tool or an available Claude image backend; no fabricated capability, credentials or silent paid fallback.. |
| `skills/brand-images/references/learning.md` | Feedback scope, approvals, candidate observations, contradictory feedback, rollback, export and deletion boundaries.. |
| `skills/brand-images/skill-invariants.json` | The prose guardrails and the baseline eval declaration. |

## Quick start

Claude Code — run in chat:

```text
/plugin marketplace add natejswenson/claude-skills
/plugin install brand-images@claude-skills
/brand-images
```

Codex — run in a terminal from the root of this repository checkout:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add "$PWD"
codex plugin add brand-images@claude-skills
```

Start a new Codex session, then invoke in chat:

```text
$brand-images
```

```bash
brand-images profile    # Initialize, inspect, validate and version a local user-specific visual profile outside the plugin checkout.
brand-images brief      # Compile a generation brief from the current profile, approved reference paths and the image request, recording the exact profile revision.
brand-images feedback   # Record explicit user feedback with source and scope; apply durable preferences as an audited profile revision while keeping one-off changes scoped to the image.
brand-images history    # Inspect runs, approvals and profile revisions without interpreting silence as approval.
brand-images rollback   # Restore a chosen prior profile as a new revision without deleting feedback history.
brand-images validate   # Check profile and run metadata, artifact existence and revision consistency offline.
```

## Triggers

- "generate an image in my style"
- "create brand images"
- "make this match my brand"
- "remember this visual preference"
- "refine my image style"
- Anything the method in `SKILL.md` covers, whether or not it is phrased that way.

## Requirements

- **Claude Code:** Allow the local file and shell tools needed by the bundled commands.
- **Codex:** Use the same bundled scripts and runtimes; Claude app connections are not imported. Connect any service required by the implemented workflow in Codex separately.
- **Personal data:** Both hosts use `~/.claude/brand-images/profiles/<slug>/`, outside the plugin checkout. Set `--home` for a separate private root. Profiles, copied images and feedback stay local. No automatic cloud sync or generic-memory capture.
- **Image generation:** Codex uses an exposed built-in image tool; Claude needs its own installed image-capable tool/connector. Without a generation capability the skill reports a ready brief, not an image. The dependency-free CLI handles profiles and receipts; it does not call a paid API.
- **Feedback:** Only explicit enduring feedback changes preferences. Profile approval and reuse of an image as a reference are separate from liking one image.

See [Codex migration notes](https://github.com/natejswenson/claude-skills/blob/main/docs/codex-migration.md) for host tools and retained data paths.

- Node 18+ (the bundled scripts are ESM, no dependencies).

## A first session

Invoke the skill with "Generate an image in my style" and a subject. With no saved profile, describe your direction or provide reference images. The skill proposes specific visual attributes and generates an onboarding sample. Approve the style when it matches your intent, or give feedback such as "always use rougher paper texture". Future invocations reload that saved version automatically.

Each result includes the actual image, the style revision used, and an honest visual review. "More texture in this one" affects one image; "always use more texture" appends a persistent preference revision. History and rollback preserve earlier style versions. Several brands can coexist in isolated profiles.

Bundled commands run with `node skills/brand-images/scripts/brand-images.js` from the plugin root (or the installed binary when explicitly installed). Run `--help` for flags; the schemas and generation/feedback boundaries are documented in `references/`.
